answer.reason: The verses state three events of the mantle: it was cast on Elisha, it divided the Jordan for Elijah and Elisha, and it divided the Jordan again when Elisha took it up.

clauses.english: was cast upon Elisha by Elijah as he passed by
clauses.quote: Elijah passed by him, and cast his mantle upon him.

clauses.english: was wrapped together and struck the Jordan, dividing its waters for Elijah and Elisha
clauses.quote: Elijah took his mantle, and wrapped it together, and smote the waters

clauses.english: fell from Elijah and was used by Elisha to part the Jordan again
clauses.quote: he took the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and smote the waters

doubts: 1KI 19:13 (Elijah wrapping his face in his mantle at the cave) is a minor detail and was left out; it may be a different occasion of the same garment.
